title: Feature: Project artifacts standard
hero: How every project gets the same status artifacts: a feature artifact per feature and one full-progress artifact for all the work, kept current automatically. Built in dev-standards as the plugin luismc-artifacts.
lede: luismc-artifacts 1.3.0 is live (ARTIFACTSPEC 1.3.0, released 11 October) and installed on the owner’s machine; 1.3.1 (AR35, AR37) is in progress. Every activity is a task, Built replaces Done, decisions are shown as option cards, and only Full Progress is published: Full Progress: dev-standards. Feature artifacts, this one included, are HTML files in docs/artifacts/.
